answer: Make every agent post a small refundable bond before it can trade. A sybil operator can forge a hundred identities, but each one ties up real money, so the attack stops paying for itself. The bond acts like a prism: honest agents pass through unchanged and get it back, while spam accounts burn it on fines and lose money fast. That turns a flood of fake accounts into an island of a few that can afford to stay. The cost is the bond itself, plus the work of earning it back through honest trades.
